author: Charles Dickens
title: A Christmas Carol
edition: Original English text of the edition explicitly identified by Project Gutenberg 19337 as published in 1905: New York, The Platt & Peck Co.; front matter states Copyright, 1905, by The Baker & Taylor Company. Prose taken directly from that edition’s HTML transcription. Source paragraph boundaries, spelling and punctuation retained; HTML formatting and page-number anchors removed, within-paragraph line-wrap whitespace reflowed. The edition’s introduction and illustrations are not included.

rights.basis: Project Gutenberg identifies this particular edition as published in 1905, gives its 1905 copyright statement and explicitly marks eBook 19337 public domain in the USA. The original-English prose edition predates 1931; no modern introduction or illustration is supplied.

acquisition.method: Project Gutenberg 19337 HTML (19337-h.htm, ISO-8859-1) from the PG mirror aleph.pglaf.org. Kept everything from the second title (A CHRISTMAS CAROL, In Prose, Being a Ghost Story of Christmas) through the end of Stave Five; removed the PG header and footer, the title page, the edition's introduction, contents and list of illustrations, illustrations and captions, and page numbers. Each P is one paragraph with line-wrap whitespace collapsed; the carol couplet is one stanza; headings keep their levels (titles level 2, subtitles level 3); italics are not marked.
